text:
rachel: Heads-up — opened a preview for the stale-toggle-eviction flow. It will mark flags with zero runtime lookups and surface a "soft-quarantine" in Console rather than immediate delete. Want ops/telemetry/UX + devex to weigh in before any hard-removal.

deepak: Important: we should use quarantine state for 14 days where reads return current value but writes are blocked unless owner confirms. That gives teams time to recover.

ops-bot: [scheduler] stale-evict.preview queued: job=stale-evict/2024-06-15T11:00Z id=sev-20240615-2 :gear:

telemetry: We'll need three events: `stale_evict.preview`, `stale_evict.quarantine.sample`, and `stale_evict.action` for any irreversible ops. Plan to sample low-traffic keys and full for >=180d untouched. Also add metric `stale_evict.quarantined_gauge`.

kelly: UX request: Console should render quarantined keys in a special panel with timeline and two CTAs — "Request restore" (owner approves) and "Mark for prune" (ops-approved). Also surface the owner resolver trace and a one-click safelist.

devex: Recommend an email digest for owners during preview listing quarantined keys + direct link to bulk-restore modal. Modal should have simple copy: why flagged, last_seen, suggested action.

sam: Ops asks for an idempotency token per sweep run and a snapshot before any prune. Also require a quorum for final prune: two approvers at minimum (ops + owner or product).

rachel: Policy draft: 1) only keys older than 90d are eligible for quarantine; 2) quarantine = 14d soft-quarantine (reads pass), 3) keys in 90-180d flagged as "monitor" in preview, not quarantined, 4) `no-evict` label overrides, 5) sampled telemetry for owner review, 6) hard prune requires snapshot + 48h tombstone + quorum approval.

telemetry: Example sample payload we'll emit:

`{"event": "stale_evict.quarantine.sample","key": "reco.max_candidates.v2","owner": "reco-service","last_seen": "2024-01-03T07:20:00Z","lookups_90d": "0","labels": ["experiment"]}`

kelly: Also show a small chart of lookups over last 180d in the key detail. Helps decide restore vs prune.

sam: Add a canary plan: quorum-only pruning disabled for first 2 weeks, then enabled for 10% tenants, then full. Add smoke-restore test that randomly restores 10 keys from snapshots weekly.

deepak: Scale notes: use shard watermarks, cursor + backoff scanning, and limit initial run to 3k keys/hour. Prefer incremental marking so we don't re-traverse entire store.

rachel: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/stale-evict/pull/9. I'll update the runbook with quorum steps and the soft-quarantine UI spec. Holding hard-prune until ops+telemetry+devex thumbs.

devex: I'll draft digest + modal copy in the PR.

ops-bot: [audit] preview-run-sev-20240615-2 started by rachel.

sam: ops ack — will draft quorum approval workflow and undelete runbook.

telemetry: ack — will add event schemas and sampling rules.

rachel: thanks all — will wait 48h for feedback then schedule canary preview. :v:
